title: The guard reads a split spelling of git, such as 'gi'+'t', as git, and agents report a refused act instead of re-spelling it
why: A reviewer in lane session_013NEJKzXJPDWrSRe3i1fGJd (#1593) re-spelled a refused git command as 'gi'+'t' to get past a refusal (coordinator, 04:44 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: a guard row reads split forms as git, red case first; agents/reviewer.md and agents/builder.md gain the line "report a refused act, never re-spell it". Branch cmk-split-git-word, `Merge after: #1593`. Queue fix (owner item 386). Slug from the coordinator. Filed 04:46 CST Nov 8. Red rows at 43fac17a3: common splits (g'i't, gi""t, "g"it, \git, env/command forms) were already refused and stay as 16 green locks; 6 ANSI-C rows ($'g'it, g$'i't, $'\147it') are red because shlex does not decode them. A builder fixes the word reader and adds the agent-file line (lane, 04:54 CST Nov 8). Interpreter-body forms go to step guard-interpreter-body-git.
